notes:
Upstream-clone debugging task on scikit-image/scikit-image at parent commit 9107d523a899b8d3767630941ac28f438bf875d2 (real upstream bug, issue #7333, fixed upstream in 119a89bc10801dd4c4557b007e97c79a06f9d24c). RegionProperties created with cache=False still write every computed property into the object's private cache dict: the _cached decorator body is 'if not ((prop in cache) and obj._cache_active): cache[prop] = f(obj); return cache[prop]', so whenever _cache_active is False it recomputes AND stores, and the region object retains every computed array (binary masks, intensity crops) for its lifetime. Values returned are identical either way, so the symptom is memory retention and a non-empty private stash; there is no traceback. Harder shape per v4.3 policy: the instruction is symptom-only (no issue number, no fix, no file, no internal names), and the agent must author its own failing reproduction at /app/repro.py as a deliverable BEFORE fixing; the verifier runs the agent's repro against the pre-fix tree (git stash) and against the repaired tree, plus the fix-commit regression test extracted to /opt/golden (test_disabled_cache_is_empty, skimage/measure/tests/test_regionprops.py), plus two authored hidden cases (3-D volume; multi-region 2-D image with holes and float intensities) that the upstream test does not use, plus the project's own full test_regionprops.py (124 tests) to prove nothing broke. The fix is a pure-Python restructure of the _cached wrapper (return f(obj) directly when cache is inactive; only write when absent and active), so no C recompile is needed. Both directions re-confirmed inside the task image with the pinned deps (numpy 2.1.3, scipy 1.14.1, Cython 3.0.12, meson-python 0.21.1): parent repro prints retained=3, golden fails at parent rc=1; with the fix applied repro prints retained=0, golden passes, all 124 in-tree tests pass. Image build measured at ~2.5 min on 1 CPU, image 1.6 GB, tests <1 s.
REVIEW (v4.3 wave, pintle-flint): directions re-confirmed inside the shipped task image with the pinned deps: parent prints retained=3 and the fix-commit golden test fails (rc=1); with the exact upstream fix applied (oracle patcher), repro prints retained=0, golden passes, both hidden cases pass, and the project's own full test_regionprops.py stays 124/124. Acceptance via `bash tools/verify_new_task.sh pintle-flint` exit 0: static lint clean, binary_reward cone ok, harbor oracle reward 1, harbor nop reward 0. Editable-install pth/loader and /opt/golden are sha-pinned in the verifier (deterministic meson-python templates, no UUID), sitecustomize/usercustomize anywhere on sys.path is rejected, a site-packages shadow 'skimage' directory is rejected, the skimage.measure._regionprops module the verifier imports is asserted to resolve to /app/src, PYTHONPATH is cleared for every verifier-side python, and provenance requires exactly one modified tracked file (an unstaged edit of skimage/measure/_regionprops.py) with no staged or untracked files in the clone. Attack round (each run as a scratch container build against the same task tree and scored by test.sh): hardcoded repro with no fix, hardcoded repro with a real fix, golden-file rewrite, staged fix, conftest.py planted in the tree, sitecustomize wrapper, shadow package in site-packages, and fetch-and-apply of the actual upstream fix (network egress exists on this host; the fix commit becomes reachable and the cat-file provenance check rejects it) all score 0; oracle still 1, nop 0. Two-leg design: the agent's own /app/repro.py must exit 0 on the repaired tree and non-zero when the single tracked change is git-stashed (pre-fix tree), so a reproduction that does not genuinely discriminate the bug cannot pass both legs.
